name: sml
description: Samva template toolchain: markup, editor and Vite plugin
author: Arya Labs, Inc.

scripts.build: bun run --filter @samva/markup build && bun run --filter @samva/editor build && bun run --filter @samva/vite build
scripts.starter:check: cd examples/email-starter && bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun test ./tests/starter-manifest.test.js
scripts.test:browser: bun run --filter @samva/editor test:browser && bun run --filter @samva/vite test:browser
